trans-unit.source: Mirald... Are you really waiting for a fool like myself...?
trans-unit.target: Mirald... Are you really waiting for a fool like myself...?

trans-unit.source: He's been all “Mirald...Mirald...” ever since he stared into the Sword of Time in Early, yeah?
trans-unit.target: He's been all “Mirald...Mirald...” ever since he stared into the Sword of Time in Early, yeah?

trans-unit.source: Ohhh, you! It's not very nice to peep after being being asked not to!
trans-unit.target: Ohhh, you! It's not very nice to peep after being asked not to!

trans-unit.source: I bet you peep on us when we're changing clothes, you sicko!
trans-unit.target: I bet you peep on us when we're changing clothes, you sicko!

trans-unit.source: I've never done that! Quit talking crap, you!
trans-unit.target: I've never done that! Quit talking crap, you!

trans-unit.source: EEEK! The Peeping Tom's assaulting me!
trans-unit.target: EEEK! The Peeping Tom's assaulting me!

trans-unit.source: Hmhm... Aren't they getting along well now?
trans-unit.target: Hmhm... Aren't they getting along well now?
